note: Every number is computed from the file named in computed_from. A blank threshold is a decision nobody has made yet, and is flagged rather than filled in.

legend.met: the number that clears the gate is reached
legend.partial: some of the evidence exists, the gate is not reached
legend.blocked: the gate is not reached and no evidence closes it
legend.unverified: cannot be computed from the repository

rows.requirement: Originate own lines and show a real edge against the market
rows.blocking_gate: G5 multiple-testing (BH-adjusted p < 0.05) and G8 (95% ROI lower bound above 0)
rows.number_now: 0 of 12 strategies pass G5; 0 of 12 pass G8
rows.number_to_clear: 1950 bets for 80% power at the top strategy's edge; 401 placed
rows.source_label: internal computation: no official source applies (flag F52)

rows.requirement: Strategies pass all eight validation gates before they rank
